# Angle and Slot parts

Generated by `ci/scenarios/mate-bounded-slot.json`: a 60 x 30 x 10 mm plate with an
8 mm wide through slot whose end axes are at x=-11 and x=11, and an 8 mm diameter
pin. Keep the archives as generated.

The regression replays the failing request with the pin at [40,7,30] mm, an Origin
on the plate, a 30-degree Angle, and a free Slot with rotation locked. It checks
the stored pose, bounded proof, fixed Origin, save and reopen.
